title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 53
paragraphs: This is the number of stages with rest-houses as one goes up from Sardis to Susa. If the royal road has been correctly measured in leagues, and if the league is equal to thirty furlongs (as it undoubtedly is), the number of furlongs from Sardis to what is called the palace of Memnon is thirteen thousand five hundred, the number of leagues being four hundred and fifty. So if one travels one hundred and fifty furlongs a day, exactly ninety days are spent on the journey.
